;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Tigray military intervention]]
**[[Amnesty International]] reports that [[massacre]]s are taking place in the [[Tigray Region]] of [[Ethiopia]] after a conflict broke out last week. Amnesty cites witnesses blaming the [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] for the "horrific tragedy" taking place as [[airstrike]]s continue to hit the region after Prime Minister [[Abiy Ahmed]] blamed the political group of committing [[war crime]]s. Amnesty's report could not identify the perpetrators of the massacres. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/amnesty-reports-massacre-in-ethiopias-tigray-as-conflict-rages-idUSKBN27S0K3 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
***[[Minister of Finance (India)|Finance Minister]] [[Nirmala Sitharaman]] announces a $35.14 billion package to stimulate the [[Economy of India|economy]] by boosting jobs, consumer demand, manufacturing, agriculture and exports hit by the COVID-19 pandemic. She said the package includes 9 billion [[Indian rupee|rupee]]s ($121 million) for development of a [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] by the government’s biotechnology department. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/india-announces-35-billion-economic-stimulus-package-74165709 (ABC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Eta]] makes landfall as a tropical storm near [[Cedar Key, Florida|Cedar Key]], [[Florida]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/eta-makes-landfall-tropical-storm-florida/story?id=74163883 (ABC News)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The [[International Organisation for Migration]] says at least 74 people have died after their boat, which was carrying more than 120 people, capsized off the coast of [[Libya]]. The [[Libyan Coast Guard]] has rescued 47 survivors. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-54922965 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Vamco (2020)|Typhoon Vamco]] makes landfall in [[Luzon]] in the [[Philippines]] and causes flooding in [[Metro Manila]] killing at least seven people. In [[Marikina]] alone, around 40,000 homes were fully or partially submerged. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKBN27S0CS (Reuters)]
*A helicopter carrying [[Multinational Force and Observers]] (MFO) peacekeepers crashes near [[Sharm el-Sheikh]], [[South Sinai Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. Seven people are killed, including five Americans, a [[French people|French]] national and a [[Czechs|Czech]] national. One crew member, an American, survived and was medically evacuated to an [[Israel]]i hospital. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-54920096 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Mayor of Chicago|Chicago Mayor]] [[Lori Lightfoot]] issues a new [[Stay-at-home order|stay-at-home]] advisory that asks people to leave the house only for work, school or other essential reasons. It is scheduled to take effect for 30 days beginning at 6:00 a.m. [[Central Time Zone|CST]] on November 16. [https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/stay-at-home-advisory-issued-for-chicago-as-city-reaches-critical-point/2368372/ (WMAQ-TV)]
*****[[Illinois]] reports 12,702 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://chicago.suntimes.com/essential-coronavirus-news/2020/11/12/21562458/illinois-coronavirus-update-covid-cases-deaths-pritzker-nov-12 (''Chicago Sun-Times'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] surpasses one million cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], becoming the second state after [[Texas]] to reach that milestone. [https://abc7.com/health/california-covid-19-cases-hit-1-million-mark/7904366/ (KABC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] reports 6,940 new cases, a new single-day record, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 236,225. [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2020/11/12/michigan-sets-new-record-daily-coronavirus-cases-adds-45-deaths/6268635002/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
*****[[Minnesota]] reports 7,228 new cases, a new single-day record, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 201,795. [https://www.startribune.com/record-7-228-covid-19-new-cases-reported-in-minnesota/573055191/ (''Star Tribune'')]
****Nationally, more than 150,000 cases are reported, setting a world record for a third consecutive day. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/medical/a-record-number-of-people-in-the-us-are-currently-hospitalized-with-covid-19/ar-BB1aXKgD (MSN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Premier of Alberta|Alberta Premier]] [[Jason Kenney]] announces new restrictions that will suspend indoor group fitness programs, team sports, group performance activities, limit the number of people who attend weddings and funeral services to 50 and reduce operating hours for restaurants, bars and pubs in the areas that are under enhanced status from tomorrow until November 27. It comes after [[Alberta]] reports a record 860 cases. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/alberta/article-alberta-to-announce-new-covid-19-measures-in-response-to-surge-in/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]]
*****[[British Columbia]] reports a record 1,130 new cases in the last two days. This number includes  536 on Wednesday and 594 on Thursday. In addition, there are a record 155 people that have been hospitalized because of the virus. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7459503/bc-coronavirus-update-november-12/ (Global News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports a record 1,575 new cases in the last 24 hours, raising its seven-day average to 1,299 cases and the cumulative cases in the [[Provinces and territories of Canada|province]] to 89,784. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/covid-19-coronavirus-ontario-november-12-new-record-high-1.5799141 (CBC)]
****Nationwide, 4,981 new cases are reported in [[Canada]] in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/canada-breaks-its-covid-19-daily-record-with-4-981-reported-cases-1.5187114 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi]]
*****[[Delhi]] reports a record 8,593 new cases in the last 24 hours, taking the total number of confirmed cases in the capital to 459,975. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Delhi/daily-covid-19-cases-cross-8k-for-first-time/article33078597.ece (''The Hindu'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****Human rights lawyer [[Nasrin Sotoudeh]] has tested positive, only days after being released from prison. [https://www.rferl.org/a/iranian-activist-sotoudeh-contracted-coronavirus-in-prison-/30941874.html (Radio Free Europe)] 
****[[Iran]] surpasses 40,000 total COVID-19 deaths after 457 new fatalities are reported in the last 24 hours. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/12/iran-passes-grim-milestone-of-40000-deaths-from-coronavirus (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Japan]] surges to a record high of 1,651 cases in the last 24 hours as Economy Minister [[Yasutoshi Nishimura]] warned of more stringent measures if the number of cases continues to rise. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/japans-covid-19-cases-hit-new-daily-high-as-third-wave-fears-rise (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] reports 1,808 new infections in the last 24 hours, the highest since July 30, raising its nationwide total to 349,992 cases, according to data from the National Command and Operation Centre. [https://nation.com.pk/12-Nov-2020/pakistan-reports-1-808-coronavirus-cases-in-one-day (''The Nation'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] surpasses 500,000 total COVID-19 cases after a record 11,057 new cases are reported in the last 24 hours. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/ukraine-sees-new-record-high-of-11057-covid-19-cases-per-day.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
****[[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] is hospitalized after he contracted COVID-19 earlier this week. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/ukraines-president-zelenskiy-hospitalized-due-to-covid-19 (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports 3,082 new cases over the past 24 hours, a new single-day record, raising the total number of cases to 75,922. [https://www.total-croatia-news.com/news/48110-croatia-has-3-082-new-covid-19-cases-32-related-deaths (Total Croatia News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports 3,316 new cases and 50 deaths over the past 24 hours, a new single-day record for both cases and deaths since the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]] began, taking the nationwide totals to 66,637 cases and 959 deaths. [https://www.thenationalherald.com/archive_general_news_greece/arthro/greece_breaks_daily_record_with_over_3_000_new_covid_cases_as_surge_quickens-1194495/ (''The National Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 636 new deaths, the highest single-day total since April 6, which brings the nationwide death toll to 43,559. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2020/11/12/covid-37978-new-cases-636-dead_c9cfa173-bd12-4136-ba8b-3107b7f8be27.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 439 new fatalities in the past 24 hours, raising the nationwide death toll to 32,032. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-russia-cases-idUKKBN27S0WS (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 33,470 new cases, a new single-day record since the pandemic began, taking the nationwide total to 1.29 million cases. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-uk-records-another-33-470-coronavirus-cases-the-highest-daily-figure-to-date-12130940 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Marshall Islands]]
****President [[David Kabua]] states that the Marshall Islands are COVID-free again after the US Army workman who had tested positive is no longer contagious. Initially, two US Armed Forces personnel had tested positive for the virus and have both recovered. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/430439/marshall-islands-free-of-covid-again (RNZ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****COVID-19 Response Minister [[Chris Hipkins]] asks [[New Zealand people|New Zealander]]s who work in the [[Auckland CBD]] to stay home if possible from tomorrow after a new case was found in the city. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/12/new-zealand-investigates-mystery-covid-case-in-auckland (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]] reports 6,195 new cases, a new single-day record since the beginning of the pandemic, taking the nationwide total to 276,821 cases. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2020/11/325629/morocco-confirms-record-breaking-6195-new-covid-19-cases-in-24-hours/ (Morocco World News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic on cruise ships]]
***In a first cruise since March, five passengers aboard the [[SeaDream I]] cruise ship have tested positive for COVID-19. [https://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/caribbean-cruise-seadream-1-covid/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Legality of cannabis]]
**[[Cannabis in Israel]]
***[[Ministry of Justice (Israel)|Justice Minister]] [[Avi Nissenkorn]] announces that [[Israel]] will begin a nine-month process to legalise and regulate recreational use of [[Cannabis (drug)|cannabis]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/legalizing-marijuana-could-happen-within-9-months-nissenkorn-648901 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Belgium]] [[deportation|expels]] five [[far-right]] [[Danes|Danish]] activists associated with [[Rasmus Paludan]], ahead of a planned [[Quran]] [[Book burning|burning]] event in [[Molenbeek-Saint-Jean]], [[Brussels]]. The area has a large [[Islam in Belgium|Muslim]] community and it was feared that the Quran burning could spark [[civil unrest]]. [[right of asylum|Asylum]] Secretary [[Sammy Mahdi]] said the group is a "serious threat to public order". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-54919127 (BBC News)]
*William Vollmar, who formerly worked as a doctor in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, was sentenced to up to 20 years in prison after pleading no contest to sexual assault charges. [https://www.fox43.com/article/news/local/lancaster-county/lancaster-county-doctor-accused-of-numerous-sexual-assault-offenses-expected-to-plead-guilty-today/521-2bb0469a-2531-48d8-be08-9eba3848943a (Fox 43)] [https://wjactv.com/news/local/authorities-pennsylvania-sports-doc-sentenced-to-prison-for-sex-abuse (WJAC TV)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Belizean general election]]
**The [[People's United Party]] wins [[Belize]]'s latest [[Elections in Belize|general election]], ending the [[United Democratic Party (Belize)|United Democratic Party]]'s rule after 12 years. [[Johnny Briceño]] will be sworn in as the next [[Prime Minister of Belize]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54922104 (BBC News)]
